scope: Independent read-only review of newly added legacy v2/v3 envelope metadata parsing. Existing Bach implementation/review was not redone. No code/native/model edits, decoding, inference, model conversion, or publication.

native_cross_checks.evidence: 0xe3dec8..0xe3dee4 adds corresponding first/second 8-byte halves; 0xe3defc..0xe3df20 constructs/version-looks-up folded string. Inspector recognizes exact v2/v3 NUL-padded result and otherwise reports header-only candidate.

native_cross_checks.claim: declared length, model name, group count
native_cross_checks.evidence: 0xe3df2c..0xe3df98 reads totalBytes and compares with actual stream length, reads signed name length and signed group count; negative values branch to rejection. Inspector additionally caps printable model name to 1..255 and group count to MAX_ENTRIES.

0xe3e000 group name; 0xe3e098 auxiliary length and data; 0xe3e130 checksum word; 0xe3e138 encoded length; 0xe3e224 tail tag; 0xe3e22c tail length/data. Inspector consumes these fields in order with containing-span checks.

native_cross_checks.claim: decoded checksum is not envelope checksum
native_cross_checks.evidence: Native decoder calls at 0xe3e0dc and 0xe3e174 precede checksum loop at 0xe3e1f0..0xe3e220. Inspector neither performs those calls nor interprets opaque payloads and explicitly sets per-group verified=false and decoded_payload_checksums_verified=false.

0xe3e3d8 reads first parameter count, first map body uses name+4-byte value at 0xe3e404..0xe3e438; second count at 0xe3e448 and second map entries at 0xe3e468..0xe3e4a0. Inspector handles float then int metadata and consumes exactly EOF.

boundary_and_claim_review: Every word/blob/name goes through span before slicing/unpacking; payload lengths are capped below signed-negative range and file size is bounded at 128 MiB.
Names are nonempty printable ASCII with stricter inspector caps; these caps define supported metadata inputs and are not claims about universal native limits.
High-bit/signed-negative counts fail MAX_ENTRIES checks, and group+float+int counts are aggregated using Python unbounded integers.
Zero groups and zero opaque blobs are structurally allowed without claiming model execution or validity.
Every recognized v2/v3 parse must end exactly at file length; unsupported folded versions remain header-only candidates with explicit opaque/no-decoding limitation.

Conflicting Bach/legacy length heuristics yield ambiguous/not_decoded; explicit legacy parses only when chosen independently. BM strong-magic path remains its pre-existing opaque header-only classifier.
Nonfinite float payloads have no numeric value and remain opaque; JSON serializes with allow_nan=false. Signed int32 metadata is decoded as signed.

Mutated encoded/auxiliary/tail payloads can remain structurally accepted, as intended; hashes change and decoded checksums remain unverified. Stored checksum/tag are not treated as decoded information.
CLI exit zero includes header-only recognition by documented contract; status must be inspected. Unknown/ambiguous exit2 and malformed identified input exit1 were exercised.
README/QA do not claim tensor/weight decoding, inference, active-device identity, HDR correctness, or full-image dimensions from face crop metadata.

goodlike.result: Full inspect result exactly equals existing QA_REAL_MODELS.models.tt_goodlike

builtin_envelopes.result: All exact input sizes/SHA pins match inventory and QA_BUILTIN_ENVELOPES; each parsed as legacy_model_envelope with decoded checksum flag false

checks: exact EOF and excess tail bytes

limits: Outer-envelope and plaintext metadata verification only; malformed encoded payloads may pass because native decoders/checksums are deliberately not run.
No claim of target-device model identity, functioning inference, parameter applicability, beauty output equivalence or HDR/high-quality reconstruction.
No Android or native execution was performed.
Review results bind to the listed inspector hash; production source was not modified.
